recommendation: Keep the source fix. It is a narrow correction to active normative search documentation, directly aligned with the issue's request to make URI search modifier examples clear, and no further FHIR-17497 source work appears necessary.
issue_request: FHIR-17497 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for unclear or misleading search modifier documentation. It requested clearer string modifier text and, for uri :above/:below, replacing the meaningless "search term left" wording with "left-matches" plus an example.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 14358, and git history shows ca121c6cb5509ccc65e6565e2b2332333a18dc4f applying the string wording and changing "left matches" to "left-matches" in source/search.html. The current source no longer has that old compact modifier list because the active Search page was later refactored into explicit modifier sections.
additional_context: source/search.html is the active FHIR-core Search page for the related FHIR-core-search artifact. Later commit 804c730f5ff6cc19e46fffe30fb697eb2f08f75e rewrote the :above/:below modifier descriptions and examples, including URI examples that satisfy FHIR-17497's example requirement, but left the POST form for the :below URI example saying url:above. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting guidance.
reconciliation: Changed only source/search.html's :below URI example POST body from url:above=http://acme.org/fhir to url:below=http://acme.org/fhir.
source_changes: source/search.html: corrected the POST body in the :below URI modifier example from url:above to url:below.

related_jiras.note: Its implementation commit rewrote search modifier examples and introduced the stale url:above value in the current :below URI POST example, although the Jira request itself concerned a range example.
